verdict.rationale: Unit is API-first: companies build directly on the platform via APIs, and the Dashboard and APIs both expose customer, account, payment, card, transaction, compliance and operational data, backed by a public API reference and webhooks. Nothing explicitly states that every Dashboard action has an API equivalent, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that Dashboard-only operations (e.g. compliance or admin actions) are available via API, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
